{{Quote|Former businessman, retired to a moon of Hosko about a decade back. Pretty sedate tastes for a Hutt, likes to avoid trouble. Now, with the Cartel-Republic alliance, he's terrified of being caught in the crossfire. So he came up with a plan.|Beryl Thorne|<ref name="Tickets" />}}
'''Garblaque''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] businessman who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==History==
Around [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]], Garblaque retired to a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hosko]], and was considered to have rather laid-back tastes for a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was terrified of conflict, and so when the [[Galactic War]] erupted, he bankrupted himself building a luxury [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] named the [[Haven (dreadnaught)|''Haven'']]. In order to pay for the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], he began auctioning off thousands of tickets to the ship, which would embark on a ten-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] pleasure cruise in order to wait out the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict.<ref name="Tickets" />

Around the same time, an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] hinted that he would like to possess the gold-plated [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] owned by Garblaque the Hutt and hired an individual to sort out an arrangement.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Gold equals Good}}</ref>
